h: Pat Utomi dares Tinubu to defend his record in a live debate
p: Political economist Pat Utomi has reportedly challenged President Tinubu to defend his achievements in a live presidential debate. Utomi has previously urged INEC to make debates compulsory for candidates. Atiku has also said he would take part in 2027 debates only if Tinubu and the APC attend.
more: Tinubu's camp skipped broadcast debates in the 2023 cycle.
No response from the presidency had been reported at the time of writing.
